searchText: Beacon chain specs `v1.1.0-beta.2` -- Mach'acuay -- released! https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/releases/tag/v1.1.0-beta.2 Shout out to <@!199561711278227457> for leading the recent Altair devnets and all the progress coming from these 🙌 The London Mainnet announcement has been updated with the newly released client versions which fix the consensus issue found on Ropsten. You can find the current best version for each client, as well as explanations on the actual issue here: https://blog.ethereum.org/2021/07/15/london-mainnet-announcement/
